proof_scope: tau#350 canonical five-workflow catalog: discovery order from one registry, describe-vs-registry identity match, actionable missing-prerequisite blockers, and retained clean-checkout launch/deep-link trace integrity

claims.proves: The public `tau workflows` CLI exposes exactly the five canonical workflows in ladder order from the same registry that executes them; describe output matches the authoritative registry descriptors; missing prerequisites fail with specific actionable blockers; the retained clean-checkout trace carries five resolved launch/progress-deep-link records with explicit mocked/live boundaries.
claims.does_not_prove: Provider/model semantic quality, desktop/mobile browser UI navigation (owned by viewer live-state tickets), post-approval resume completion of rungs 4-5, or GOAL.md product acceptance.

capability_claims.description: tau workflows list shows exactly the five canonical workflows ordered by rung from one registry, describe matches the registry, and the retained clean-checkout trace records five resolved launch/deep-link records with mocked=false/live=true boundaries.
Missing required launch inputs produce specific actionable blockers instead of tracebacks or guessed healthy state.

cases.name: missing-goal-blocks-with-actionable-option-error
